topic: How real-time deal visibility changed the way a business owner prioritised their week
format: Walk through the before and after in precise detail — same task, completely different experience from start to finish
post:

This week, he opens his pipeline dashboard. Seven deals. Live status. Last activity. Next action — all there before his first coffee.

He reprioritised his entire week in under five minutes.

That's not a small thing. That's the difference between chasing and leading.

No more piecing things together from WhatsApp threads and spreadsheets. One screen, Monday morning, everything visible.
